prompts.description: Describe the S3 Spine structural graph including nodes, edges, semantics, and causal direction.
Traverse the S3 Spine graph from a given start node following canonical sequencing rules.
Apply a spine operator (push, pull, bind, gradient, fieldShift, ruptureForce) and describe resulting semantic changes.
Validate an operator sequence against canonical sequencing rules.
Apply dimensional amplification to a spine semantic using the 10-dimension subsystem.
Explain how a specific dimension (L4, L5, L8, L10, L12, L16, L26, L32, LH, LI) interacts with operators and semantics.
Load a spine example envelope (canonical, reality, imagination, information, error, qmroot).
Describe the purpose and interpretation layer of a spine example envelope.
Explain the operational protocol for interacting with the S3 Spine subsystem.
Describe the MCP server configuration, capabilities, and endpoints for the S3 Spine subsystem.
Explain the AI metadata structure for the S3 Spine subsystem.
Describe the unified registry structure for the S3 Spine subsystem.
Describe the resource catalog for the S3 Spine subsystem.
